verdict.rationale: RudderStack is a customer data platform, so AI decisioning over messages, timing and channels is a fair question for it. The evidence covers event collection, profiles, audience building and sync, and AI agents (Slack and MCP) for managing workspaces and debugging pipelines. Nothing documents agents that autonomously choose messages, timing or channels per customer, operator-set guardrails, or measured lift.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI decisioning agents pick messages, timing, and channels per customer autonomously within guardrails I set, with measurable lift
